newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks seen steady despite profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks seen steady despite profit-taking.

text.p: Jakarta stocks are seen steady on Tuesday, but any possible sharp upside is likely to be limited following recent strong gains, brokers said.
"We expect profit taking after the recent rises. Prices can't rise all the time, there must be a time for profit taking," one broker said.
Another broker said the Dow Jones' fall overnight was also likely to prompt profit-taking on the local market.
The Jakarta composite index made strong gains recently due to improved sentiment following last week's general elections, brokers said.
Active local buying of small stocks particularly in the property sector, however, was likely to continue for speculative reasons, brokers said.
Brokers said small property firm Surya Semesta was likely to remain active.
Surya made strong gains in the past several days due to market talk that a foreign firm would buy a stake in Surya and expected strong first quarter results.
Surya Semesta announced on Tuesday it posted a net profit of 28.28 billion rupiah against a net loss of 10.03 billion rupiah in the same period last year.
On Monday, the Jakarta composite index rose 3.70 points, or 0.53 percent, to 699.73 points.
